decisions.reason: Its flame-retardant jacquard curtain concept sits squarely in the firm's established functional and contract-textile knowledge base, so the firm can keep learning from market feedback and refining it with its own R&D.

Although less prominently marketed and somewhat more exposed to portfolio rationalisation, this double-face wool-blend decoration fabric still builds on familiar design and material capabilities, so it remains worth retaining for now.

This braided-structure upholstery and curtain fabric extends existing weaving and interior-textile know-how, and its dedicated presentation suggests the firm sees enough strategic and learnable potential to continue backing it.
